diagnosticExplanations.initialCase: WebKit full install in ephemeral context
diagnosticExplanations.cause: Real ephemeral quota1048576000B was below the app required estimate. Refused early with clear storage message. Persistent isolated profile quota20615843021B supports full actual install.
Active service workers bypassed network routes. Disabling service workers only in routed fixtures restores intended synthetic data. Real full offline test retains service worker.

Genuine synchronous ResizeObserver layout writes caused an undelivered-notification loop. Red narrow layout regression; production fix defers width-triggered writes to requestAnimationFrame. Final layout and real offline run have no pageerrors.
